hints.tr: Her çalışanı bir "kök" yapıp altındakileri listeleyen özyineleme: `SELECT id AS manager_id, id AS member_id FROM employees UNION ALL SELECT t.manager_id, e.id FROM employees e JOIN team t ON e.manager_id = t.member_id`.
hints.en: A recursion that makes every employee a "root" and lists everyone below them: `SELECT id AS manager_id, id AS member_id FROM employees UNION ALL SELECT t.manager_id, e.id FROM employees e JOIN team t ON e.manager_id = t.member_id`.

hints.tr: Satış ayrı bir CTE: çalışan başına ciro. Ekip satırlarına `LEFT JOIN` ile bağla (satışı olmayan üye düşmesin), kişinin kendisini `WHERE t.member_id <> t.manager_id` ile çıkar, yöneticiye göre grupla; boş toplamı `COALESCE(..., 0)`.
hints.en: Sales is a separate CTE: revenue per employee. Attach it to the team rows with `LEFT JOIN` (so members without sales do not drop out), take out the person themselves with `WHERE t.member_id <> t.manager_id`, group by manager; turn an empty total into `COALESCE(..., 0)`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
WITH team AS (
    SELECT id AS manager_id, id AS member_id FROM employees
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.manager_id, e.id
    FROM employees e
    JOIN team t ON e.manager_id = t.member_id
),
sales AS (
    SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.employee_id
)
SELECT m.name,
       COUNT(*) AS team_size,
       COALESCE(SUM(s.revenue), 0) AS team_revenue
FROM team t
JOIN employees m ON m.id = t.manager_id
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.employee_id = t.member_id
WHERE t.member_id <> t.manager_id
GROUP BY m.id, m.name
ORDER BY team_revenue DESC, m.name;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
WITH team AS (
    SELECT id AS manager_id, id AS member_id FROM employees
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.manager_id, e.id
    FROM employees e
    JOIN team t ON e.manager_id = t.member_id
),
sales AS (
    SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.employee_id
)
SELECT m.name,
       COUNT(*) AS team_size,
       COALESCE(SUM(s.revenue), 0) AS team_revenue
FROM team t
JOIN employees m ON m.id = t.manager_id
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.employee_id = t.member_id
WHERE t.member_id <> t.manager_id
GROUP BY m.id, m.name
ORDER BY team_revenue DESC, m.name;
```

hint.tr: Doğrudan ve dolaylı alt çalışanlar özyinelemeli bir `WITH` ile bulunuyor: başlangıç, `UNION ALL`, kendini çağıran parça.
hint.en: Direct and indirect subordinates are found with a recursive `WITH`: the start, `UNION ALL`, the self-referring part.
